subject: Problems with function gplot from rasterVis, a wrapper of ggplot

messages.author: fdaa54d30ab7b913
messages.subject: Problems with function gplot from rasterVis, a wrapper of ggplot
parts:
Dear list members,

I am trying to plot point on a map using teh following code and got an error.  The question is not completely about ggplot2 but is related. Function gplot is from rasterVis and is a wrapper function around ggplot.

> library(raster)
> library(rasterVis)
> r = raster(jabali$map)
> p = gplot(r) + geom_tile(aes(fill = value)) + geom_point(loc, aes(X,Y))
Error: ggplot2 doesn't know how to deal with data of class uneval

I can plot the map with the first part of the code (geom_tile), but I cannot get to plot the points on the map (geom_point).  The object "loc" is a data frame with the locations given by X and Y. "r" is a raster layer created by the raster package.
